scenarios.title: Maintenance Date is not used outside the specified current-eligibility relevant-field change rule
Inbound processing identifies all three named dates available for transaction effective date selection
Backward-compatible processing continues to apply the updated date-selection rules on update files
gaps: TC_003 is the closest related case, but the scenario also requires "3) Update/change processing in a U-prefixed file applies the current-eligibility relevant-field-change rule with unchanged Assessment Date and selects Maintenance Date." The table only covers the grouping in TC_003 as "the relevant changed field grouping is Aid Category plus Rate Cell" / "change Aid Category and Rate Cell only"; add a dedicated test case for another listed relevant-field grouping such as "Pregnancy Indicator + Rate Cell" or "Pregnancy Indicator + Aid Category + Rate Cell" if that numbered condition is intended to enumerate supported update/change patterns.

gaps: Coverage gap attached to TC_002: scenario description requires "2) Rule path selecting Assessment Date does not create a capitation/reporting discrepancy." and the authoritative glossary enumerates a separate named grouping "Assessment Number + Assessment Tier + Assessment Division" under "NAMED GROUPINGS, each enumerated as its own condition:"; add a dedicated test case for the Assessment Date path with that grouping because TC_002 only covers "only Pregnancy Indicator and Rate Cell changed so that the business rule should select the Assessment Date."

Coverage gap attached to TC_003: scenario description requires "3) Rule path selecting Maintenance Date does not create a capitation/reporting discrepancy." and the authoritative glossary enumerates a separate named grouping "Aid Category + Rate Cell" under "NAMED GROUPINGS, each enumerated as its own condition:"; add a dedicated test case for the Maintenance Date path with that grouping because TC_003 only covers "only Pregnancy Indicator, Aid Category, and Rate Cell changed so that this case exercises the Maintenance Date rule path called out by the story."
